skill_name: Come up with a data story involving the following data set.
workflow: The data reveals that people working in the same industry spend drastically different amounts of time in meetings on average. For example, while some industries require as much as 8.5 hours a day spent in short, frequent meetings, others require as little as 2.5 hours. This suggests that some industries are much more highly dependent on collaborative work, while others may focus more on solo tasks.
